name: @sos-2/tests-real-github
description: SOS 2.0 Real GitHub Connectivity Suites (Work Order P17-B): TWO strictly separated suites. (1) The DETERMINISTIC reference-mode suite — offline (a scripted GitHubRequestPort and a scripted fetch — no network, fixed vitest seed 424242, run-to-run identical): the field-for-field alignment of @sos-2/real-github's structural github vocabulary with the REAL frozen P4 package sources (non-literal dynamic imports — the P8 pinning precedent), the frozen GitHubPort contract compliance of the real provider (typed outcomes, honest connection discipline — CONNECTED only after the PAT-backed real handshake probe, the implemented OAuth surface), REST request/response mapping (discovery, branches, snapshot + empty-repository detection, webhook, branch creation, the Git Data API single-commit path, the contents-API initial commit on an empty repository, PR operations), honest error mapping (404/401/403-rate-limit/5xx/network → typed UNSUPPORTED carrying the truthful status; GH rate limits surface as DEGRADED with REAL reset data — never a fake success), and the secret redaction discipline (the credential never appears in outcomes, notes, provider-state reports, telemetry or request logs — env NAMES only). (2) The env-gated REAL-provider integration suite (RUN_REAL=1, default OFF): REAL authenticated operations against the private scratch repository payswapdotorg/sos-connectivity-scratch — create, discover, import (exact SHA), branch, commit, open PR, read PR state, close PR, delete — recording REAL outcomes as machine-readable JSON evidence with exact API revisions, timestamps and URLs.
